args.sql:
SELECT 
    mktcombo AS market_pair_name,
    spreadrate AS spread_percentage,
    mktfeel AS overall_market_mood,
    buyforce,
    PERCENTILE_DISC(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY spreadrate) OVER (
        PARTITION BY mktfeel
    ) AS avg_spread_percentage_for_mood,
    PERCENTILE_DISC(
        (
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                ORDER BY 
                    spreadrate
            ) - 1
        ) / (
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER () - 1
        ) * 100
    ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY spreadrate) AS percentile_ranking
FROM 
    marketdata,
    LATERAL jsonb_to_record(quote_depth_snapshot) AS qds( 
        spread spread_info,
        metadata metadata_info
    ),
    LATERAL jsonb_to_record(spread_info) AS si(
        spreadband DOUBLE PRECISION,
        spreadrate DOUBLE PRECISION
    ),
    LATERAL jsonb_to_record(metadata_info) AS mi(
        mktcombo VARCHAR
    ),
    analyticsindicators ai
WHERE 
    marketdata.marketdatanode = ai.mdataref
GROUP BY 
    mktcombo, spreadrate, mktfeel, buyforce
ORDER BY 
    mktcombo, spreadrate, mktfeel, buyforce;

    PERCENTILE_DISC(
        (
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                ORDER BY 
                    spreadrate
            ) - 1
        ) / (
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER () - 1
        ) * 100
    ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY spreadrate) AS percentile_ranking
FROM 
    marketdata,
    LATERAL jsonb_to_record(quote_depth_snapshot) AS qds( 
        'spread' spread_info,
        'metadata' metadata_info
    ),
    LATERAL jsonb_to_record(spread_info) AS si(
        spreadband DOUBLE PRECISION,
        spreadrate DOUBLE PRECISION
    ),
    LATERAL jsonb_to_record(metadata_info) AS mi(
        mktcombo VARCHAR
    ),
    analyticsindicators ai
WHERE 
    marketdata.marketdatanode = ai.mdataref
GROUP BY 
    mktcombo, spreadrate, mktfeel, buyforce
ORDER BY 
    mktcombo, spreadrate, mktfeel, buyforce;

SELECT 
    mktcombo AS market_pair_name,
    spreadrate AS spread_percentage,
    mktfeel AS overall_market_mood,
    buyforce,
    PERCENTILE_DISC(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY spreadrate) OVER (
        PARTITION BY mktfeel
    ) AS avg_spread_percentage_for_mood,
    PERCENTILE_DISC(
        (
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                ORDER BY 
                    spreadrate
            ) - 1
        ) / (
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER () - 1
        ) * 100
    ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY spreadrate) AS percentile_ranking
FROM 
    marketdata
JOIN 
    analyticsindicators ai ON marketdata.marketdatanode = ai.mdataref
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_record(quote_depth_snapshot) AS qds( 
        spread spread_info,
        metadata metadata_info
    )
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_record(spread_info) AS si(
        spreadband DOUBLE PRECISION,
        spreadrate DOUBLE PRECISION
    )
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_record(metadata_info) AS mi(
        mktcombo VARCHAR
    )
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_record(market_sentiment_indicators) AS msi(
    momentum momentum_info
)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_record(momentum_info) AS m(
    mktfeel VARCHAR,
    buyforce DOUBLE PRECISION
)
GROUP BY 
    mktcombo, spreadrate, mktfeel, buyforce
ORDER BY 
    mktcombo, spreadrate, mktfeel, buyforce;
